dependency_mode: GNU -MM project dependencies only; standard/system headers are not archived or rechecked by static reader
fresh_output: record_state.json exclusive claim; reject any existing generated output or manifest
checkpoints: initial, before and after each of eight stages, complete; exact exit/signal/timeout and streams
interruption_scope: SIGINT/SIGTERM/timeout handlers prepared but not yet exercised; incomplete capture never accepted as closed evidence

oracle.tolerance: baseline non-dyadic values: 16*2^-52*max(1,abs(exact rational)); other numeric expectations exact dyadic

mutation.scope: condense direct-point exit only; prepare unchanged

reader_scope: STATIC hash-first archive/code/capture validation; no imports of captured source, no native reexecution, no external dependency reads
scope: three-node abstract PointDendrogram API; no Scene/cloud/FULL/G4/GCP qualification
original_capture_status: OPEN diagnostic unchanged; no original capture copied or reclassified
